summary:
The maintained --measure-only/--preflight-only guard hashes typeof<option<int>>.Assembly.Location in the validator's own FSI process. Ordinary SDK400 CI through --output does not exercise that guard. Its required Core7516 is the public FSharp.Core 10.1.401 lib/netstandard2.0/FSharp.Core.dll (SHA256 7516a966abc789eab916e95d429bf3a49e996257069d97f7f3eb5d47373fa72b), not the package's netstandard2.1/Core39b or SDK401's bundled Core223. Public package/member verification supplies this identity; private supplier inventories and runtime assets are not Atlas content.

The supported separate role uses an owned SDK401 FSI15.2.401.0/FSharp dependency directory, adjacent Microsoft.NETCore.App10.0.12 runtime and hostfxr, host executable and SDK-parent dotnet.dll, materialized as ordinary owned files rather than a symlinked SDK entry. Probe actual loaded host, FSI, Core and framework paths/hashes before using it; a copied Core file is not a loaded-identity proof. The canonical plan retains the failed earlier symlink claim and its actual Core223 outcome. Direct owned-host/FSI --exec script invocation supplies --root and --preflight-only without an extra literal -- script boundary. Nested FSI and Fantomas use the actual observed owned401 host/entry; ordinary SDK400 apphost/generation remains a separately identified role. Never modify global SDK/package files or weaken the loaded-Core guard.

Dated root-accepted local observation on 2026-10-23: one new owned401 operation passed the existing focused route with 18 sampling calls, three interaction checks and four whole-module projections. Its single original preflight took 138.662 seconds with sampled aggregate RSS peak 1,418,498,048 bytes under a local one-CPU/four-GiB operating profile. The loaded-closure probe, original process births, EOF/retirement and private receipts stay in root custody outside Atlas; the cited source describes the route and limits, not independent proof of these run metrics. This result is bounded sampling/native replay, not full formal qualification, hostile-payload enforcement, production reception or evidence that the frozen one-CPU/two-GiB LEARN workload fits. Earlier SDK400 generation/three raw traces and 106/8/7 controls remain their original environment's evidence and are not relabelled as owned401 results.

Future invocation still needs separately admitted frozen source/tool/closure preimages, actual loaded identity, finite original whole-tree operating/retirement budget, resource headroom, private caches/no-network custody and independent result review. Retain original failures/partials and do not retry or renew an uncertain attempt. Source integration and unrelated helper/Atlas merges do not by themselves require replaying a byte-identical determining source population.
title: Focused preflight requires the actual owned401 FSI Core7516 role
